heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 101–510, div. A, title XV, § 1532(b)(1), Nov. 5, 1990, 104 Stat. 1733

notes.text: Section, R.S. § 4824, related to coverage of inmates by Articles of War. See section 801 et seq. of Title 10, Armed Forces.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective one year after Nov. 5, 1990, see section 1541(a) of Pub. L. 101–510, formerly set out as an Effective Date note under section 401 of this title.
